title: Capability và internal-admin isolation
scope_items: Canonical Goose SQL migration (infra/migrations/00003_p0_07_capability_and_admin_isolation.sql) creating capability_state enum (§3), capability_snapshots (§18.2), policy_notes (§18.2B), fallback_paths (§18.2C), platform_health_scores (§22.15), moderation_cases (§17.4), fraud_cases (§17.5), feature_flags (§17.6), system_announcements (§17.7), incidents, post_mortems, and system_alerts (§17.10-17.11) with ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, admin_ops_scope policies (§26.13), same-tenant composite foreign keys fk_fallback_paths_related_policy_note_id_tenant and fk_platform_health_scores_connected_account_id_tenant (§26.11), and narrow per-role grants (§26.12)

Compiled CapabilityService and InternalAdminService Protobuf contracts (protos/creativanta/admin/v1/capability.proto, protos/creativanta/admin/v1/internal_admin.proto) and 4-target generated artifacts (Go, Go Connect, TypeScript ES, Dart/Flutter gRPC)

Capability & Connector Verification Registry runtime (apps/api/internal/capability) enforcing 5-state capability classification (native, read_only, manual, degraded, unsupported), 24h capability_snapshots TTL with fail-closed validation on missing/stale/non-native routes, connected_accounts OAuth token redaction, 6-dimension weighted platform_health_scores calculation with proactive coaching (<50 flag, <30 auto-pause), and read-only impersonation mutation blocking

Isolated Internal Admin Console backend (apps/api/internal/internaladmin) enforcing internal-only listener (:8443) + VPN/mTLS + MFA session verification, zero workspace-role overlap, read-only impersonation with 30-minute auto-expiry and mandatory reason (>=15 chars), moderation rules engine (HARD_BLOCK immediate auto-reject + self-review guard), feature flags & global kill switches halting capability validation within SLA, and BIGINT-only manual credit adjustments

Web Capability Matrix (/settings/capabilities, W126) and Connected Accounts (/settings/connections, W120), Internal Admin Console (apps/admin, A001-A037), and Mobile Connections & Capability Screen (apps/mobile, M057) with unit and widget tests
verified_sub_slices: Unverified, stale (>24h), read_only, manual, degraded, unsupported, token-expired, and kill-switch-halted routes cannot execute native actions and return structured fallback instructions (TestUnverifiedStaleReadOnlyAndKilledRoutesCannotExecute)

6-dimension weighted Platform Health Score (0-100), proactive coaching (<50 flag, <30 auto-pause), strict OAuth token redaction, and read-only impersonation blocking on CapabilityService mutations verified (TestCompositeHealthScoresProactiveCoachingTokenRedactionAndImpersonationReadOnly)

Workspace roles (owner, admin, editor, finance, analyst, viewer) and non-VPN/non-MFA callers are rejected on the isolated admin listener (:8443) with PERMISSION_DENIED (TestWorkspaceRoleCannotCallAdminListenerAndVPNMFAGate)

Impersonation is strictly read_only, requires reason >=15 chars, blocks impersonating internal admins, auto-expires after 30 minutes, logs every start/end in append-only internal_audit_logs, and rejects all mutating requests while active (TestImpersonationIsStrictlyReadOnlyAndAutoExpiresAfter30Minutes)

Moderation rules engine HARD_BLOCK auto-rejects immediately without queuing for human review, enforces the self-review guard (assigned_admin_id != content_owner_id), and kill switch activation immediately halts capability execution (TestModerationRulesHardBlockSelfReviewGuardAndKillSwitchHaltsCapability)
Up and Down SQL statements in 00003_p0_07_capability_and_admin_isolation.sql validated by pglast PostgreSQL AST parser and static contract validator

decisions: Created canonical Goose SQL migration 00003_p0_07_capability_and_admin_isolation.sql installing capability_state enum, capability_snapshots, policy_notes, fallback_paths, platform_health_scores, moderation_cases, fraud_cases, feature_flags, system_announcements, incidents, post_mortems, and system_alerts with ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, composite same-tenant FKs (§26.11), and narrow app_user vs admin_user grants (§26.12).

Implemented M22 CapabilityService (apps/api/internal/capability) with fail-closed pre-execution gate: any missing, stale (>24h), read_only, manual, degraded, unsupported, token-expired, or kill-switch-halted route is blocked from native execution and returns structured fallback instructions.

Implemented 6-dimension weighted Platform Health Score (0-100) and proactive coaching (<50 warning flag, <30 auto-pause) while ensuring encrypted OAuth tokens are never serialized in responses or logs.

Implemented S26 InternalAdminService (apps/api/internal/internaladmin) bound to the isolated admin listener (:8443) requiring internal_admins identity, VPN/mTLS network proof, and active TOTP/WebAuthn MFA, rejecting all workspace roles with PERMISSION_DENIED.

Enforced strictly read_only impersonation with 30-minute auto-expiry, mandatory reason (>=15 chars), prohibition on impersonating internal admins, append-only internal_audit_logs capture, and runtime rejection of all mutating requests under impersonation.
notes: P0-07 implementation and all local static, SQL AST, Go race, proto 4-target, transport security, identity, smoke, self-test, Svelte/Node, and Flutter checks are complete (LOCAL_IMPLEMENTED).
